summary: Cenovus Energy filed a Form 6-K containing its first-quarter 2026 results, including adjusted funds flow of ~$3.4B, free funds flow of $2.2B, and record upstream production of 972,100 BOE/d. The board approved a 10% dividend increase to $0.22/share starting Q2 2026. Shareholder returns totaled $1.0B in Q1 through dividends, buybacks, and preferred redemptions. This is a routine earnings release with no M&A, activist, or special-situation catalyst. No deal terms are present. The filing is a standard quarterly update.
